title.source: Fundadora de las Misioneras de la Caridad
title.text: Founder of the Missionaries of Charity

biography.source: Anjezë Gonxhe Bojaxhiu, conocida como Madre Teresa, fundó en Calcuta las Misioneras de la Caridad para servir a personas pobres, enfermas y abandonadas. Recibió el Premio Nobel de la Paz en 1979.
biography.text: Anjezë Gonxhe Bojaxhiu, known as Mother Teresa, founded the Missionaries of Charity in Calcutta to serve people who were poor, ill and abandoned. She received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979.

birthPlace.text: Skopje, then in the Ottoman Empire

symbols.0.text: White sari with a blue border
